verdict.rationale: skills.sh has no documented API. The official CLI is the programmatic surface: it can search by keyword or owner (`skills find`), list a repo's skills, and add, list, update and remove skills non-interactively, which covers the discover-and-install core of the web directory. A community member explicitly asks skills.sh to "make a REST API," which indicates none exists, and nothing shows the leaderboard or ranking data can be reached programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API, programmatic access to leaderboard/ranking data, explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, and independent corroboration.
